observations: Fresh raw provider readback recovered CURRENT_POINTER, CURRENT_STATE, ROLE_INDEX and ROLE_VIEWS. CURRENT_POINTER reports ACTIVE_RESEALED_AFTER_EXACT_PROVIDER_READBACK and binds the exact observed STATE/INDEX/VIEWS SHA-256 values.

Immutable stable-root markers that still describe pre-closure D1/D4 state are explicitly superseded operationally by provider-read additive R64 closure/current-state evidence rather than silently ignored.
The deterministic R38.3 qualification returns PASS with decision_count=0: D1 and D4 are suppressed as ALREADY_CLOSED; D5 is suppressed as WAITING_REPLY_NO_REPEAT_OUTREACH.
Qualification effects are zero: no Drive write, scheduler change, external message, provider/model call, dispatch, execution, self-application, trading or capital authority.
missing_proof: No proof is missing at this exact readback; requalification is required if any bound root hash, pointer reseal status, additive decision evidence, D5 operator status or effect ceiling changes.
surfaces.promotion_rule: CURRENT is valid only for the exact bound root/evidence set recorded by R38.3; any drift returns to fail-closed requalification. Promotion/refresh remains human-gated.
